runtime_implementation.opaque_native_representation_2026_11_14: Partial, compile-only: opaque native 3DM import stages a separately reserved representation and scene pin with transaction rollback; document geometry still owns the same display, and cold rebuild is unproved. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-canonical-representation-transfer.md#opaque-native-representation-in-progress
runtime_implementation.native_source_owner_2026_11_14: Partial, compile-only: tracked native B-rep source leases use a payload-and-CRC-only owner; document geometry still owns the display and the separation is not complete. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-canonical-representation-transfer.md#native-source-ownership-in-progress
runtime_implementation.builder_topology_owner_2026_11_14: Transient Ring Builder B-rep uses independent source, shared topology and display reservation owners, including per-owner metadata. Product fixtures confirm both source-only and display-only lifetime/charge release. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-builder-split-candidate-owners.md#independent-shared-topology-owner
runtime_implementation.builder_split_candidate_owners_2026_11_1: Transient Ring Builder B-rep candidates now have separately accounted source/topology and display owners. A product fixture confirms display bytes are released while only the source survives; pin and invalid-account checks pass. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-builder-split-candidate-owners.md
runtime_implementation.hover_source_copy_worker_2026_11_14: Large-scene hover source validation and copying runs on one admitted cancelable worker; its captured document is released before picking. Headless New/cancel/pressure and retry/permit fixtures pass. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-detached-hover-source.md#source-copy-preparation-on-the-worker
runtime_implementation.detached_hover_source_2026_11_14: Background hover uses an admitted document-independent picking snapshot with exact curve copies and display pins, and rejects a changed scene publication. Headless parity, source lifetime, pressure and stale-result fixtures pass. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-detached-hover-source.md
runtime_implementation.remesh_cache_source_rebind_2026_11_14: A stored remesh representation can be rebound to the current stamp after validated same-source proof reuse. One OCCT placement/Undo/Redo fixture checks buffer identity, placement, stale stamp, independent-source refusal and simulated budget failure. Evidence: docs/validation/2026-11-14-remesh-cache-source-rebind.md

isocurve_explicit_worker_commit_20261114.scope: Controller can explicitly start and poll admitted source-only Isocurve construction, guard context, block command input and commit one transaction. Sphere fixture checks managed-pressure refusal, preserved pending input/Redo, retry, source geometry and Undo/Redo; 24 Isocurve lib/UI tests passed.
isocurve_explicit_worker_commit_20261114.limitations: Normal CMD/menu/UI construction still synchronous; UI draft guard and asynchronous recovery not wired. NativeBrep/ray, native peak, desktop, physical OOM, C1-C5 and synchronous hole verifier remain open.

isocurve_construction_job_20261114.scope: Added a source-only admitted Isocurve construction job with permit, cancellation, output lifetime and controller context checks. One fixture checks worker thread, sphere geometry, parameter/selection stale refusal, cancellation and simulated budget refusal.
isocurve_construction_job_20261114.limitations: Job is not wired to product polling, CMD draft guard, asynchronous recovery or atomic commit. Native peak, desktop, physical OOM, other geometry/routes and C1-C5 remain open.

captured_isocurve_source_20261114.scope: Non-ray OCCT B-rep Isocurve commit now uses a tracked canonical source lease and drops it before transaction. A gated worker fixture releases its Document/display before producing clipped curves, retains output quota and checks cancellation/admission refusal. Isocurve integration 57 passed/4 ignored; 22 app lib/UI tests passed.
captured_isocurve_source_20261114.limitations: Product curve construction remains synchronous; ray and NativeBrep routes differ. Worker publication guards, physical OOM, native peak, desktop, synchronous hole verifier and C1-C5 remain open.

isocurve_bounds_worker_20261114.scope: Face verification worker now computes selected OCCT B-rep Isocurve UV bounds from its tracked source and releases source/display before publishing a guarded receipt. Tests verify different worker thread, stale-selection refusal, bounds-phase managed admission refusal, and CMD/menu geometry and Undo/Redo.
isocurve_bounds_worker_20261114.limitations: Other source-ray and NativeBrep routes and later curve construction still include synchronous work; physical OOM, native peak, desktop, plain kernel hole verification and C1-C5 remain open.

isocurve_face_worker_all_sizes_20261114.scope: Removed the 512-triangle threshold for selected-root OCCT B-rep face verification. Saved one-hole and five-hole fixtures use the worker through CMD/menu, produce correct clipped curves, preserve Undo/Redo and reject stale selection. Isocurve integration 56 passed/4 ignored; 21 matching app lib/UI tests passed.
isocurve_face_worker_all_sizes_20261114.limitations: Viewport-ray and NativeBrep routes differ; source bounds/result production still includes synchronous work. Plain synchronous kernel hole verification still fails; physical OOM, native peak, desktop and C1-C5 remain open.

hole_face_worker_remesh_20261114.scope: Captured-source face worker retries the strict trim-crossing refusal with admitted exact source remesh, topology/triangle and witness checks. Saved drilled-block source tests reject altered display, stale selection, cancellation and admission denial; five-hole ExtractIsocurve menu/CMD output and Undo/Redo passed.
hole_face_worker_remesh_20261114.limitations: Synchronous verifier remains unchanged: full BRep precision suite 22 passed/1 failed. Other geometry/profiles, all face consumers, desktop, native peak, physical OOM and C1-C5 remain open.

hole_source_remesh_probe_20261114.scope: Authored drilled block after save/open regenerates exactly matching vertices, face-indexed triangles and face-edge incidence at two deflections; added cross-hole triangle and altered face label differ.
hole_source_remesh_probe_20261114.limitations: No product acceptance changed; strict full-face test still fails. One geometry and pinned OCCT only, no general determinism, typed binding, managed admission, cancellation, desktop or C1-C5 completion.

line_snap_admission_refusal_20261114.scope: Line Surface Snap refuses a point if its detached occlusion snapshot cannot be admitted, rather than running the source proof synchronously on UI. Scheduler pressure/retry and two egui click fixtures passed; 23 surface-snap tests passed, one ignored.
line_snap_admission_refusal_20261114.limitations: Scene snapshot creation and source copies still run on UI. Other commands and Gumball remain synchronous; physical OOM, desktop, native peak, curved-hole full-face failure and C1-C5 remain open.

trim_fallback_occlusion_worker_20261114.scope: Copied eligible trim fallback source and extension under independent admission and used the shared conservative proof on the Line Surface Snap worker. One affine 1025-vertex cylindrical fixture checks scheduler result, source lifetime after New, negative proof and simulated admission refusal/retry.
trim_fallback_occlusion_worker_20261114.limitations: Snapshot capture and source copies still happen on UI; failure to admit falls back to synchronous proof. Other commands, native peak, desktop, physical OOM, arbitrary trims, curved-hole integration failure and C1-C5 remain open.

line_occlusion_worker_20261114.scope: Line Surface Snap worker refines source and checks ordinary detached display occlusion; headless UI receipt, sphere plus foreground mesh, stale camera and admitted snapshot New/lifetime fixtures passed.
line_occlusion_worker_20261114.limitations: Visible trim fallback and snapshot admission failure retain synchronous UI proof; snapshot capture runs on UI. Other commands and Gumball, native peak, desktop, full-face trim failure and C1-C5 remain open.

detached_occlusion_snapshot_20261114.scope: Validated triangle/entity bindings, detached scene buffers from strong Document ownership, and shared live-scene occlusion query; two snapshot fixtures and three existing app occlusion tests passed.
detached_occlusion_snapshot_20261114.limitations: Snapshot not integrated with product worker, fallback proof still on UI; native allocation peak, desktop, general geometries and curved-trim full-face failure remain unverified. Canonical document still owns display and C1-C5 remain open.

line_surface_mode_guard_20261114.scope: A pending Line Surface Snap click records its viewport and display mode; the occupied-worker egui sphere fixture verifies immediate cancellation after a Wireframe/Shaded change, and existing input, pointer and camera cases.
line_surface_mode_guard_20261114.limitations: Other commands, Gumball and some occlusion work remain synchronous; physical desktop, native peak, true OOM and full-face curved-trim integration remain unverified. Canonical document still owns display; C1-C5 remain open.

line_surface_worker_ui_20261114.scope: Line viewport Surface Snap schedules source-only refinement and guards deferred clicks; headless sphere fixture verifies the exact source point and cancellation on new input.
line_surface_worker_ui_20261114.limitations: Other commands, Gumball and some occlusion work remain synchronous; native peak, desktop, real OOM, view-change coverage and curved-trim integration failure remain open. Canonical Document still owns display; C1-C5 remain open.

large_trim_support_2026_11_13.scope: A 28x28 planar trimmed surface with a hole and metadata over 16 KiB now fits the separate default 128 KiB trim limit. Tested insertion and Undo/Redo, OM9 save/open, scene picking and incremental update, ExtractWireframe and isocurve after reopen, STL and real 3DM export/reimport. Other names and extension limits remain separate; managed-pressure refusal preserves document/Redo in the wireframe fixture.
large_trim_support_2026_11_13.remaining: Older builds can reject files with trim metadata over 16 KiB. Arbitrary trim topology, physical OOM, native peak, independent Rhino and desktop remain open. The debug native adapter still rejects the packet schema; Plan A remains open.
large_trim_support_2026_11_13.next_action: Reconcile the debug native adapter without disrupting active user sessions, then verify the scoped workflow on desktop; continue Plan A remaining gates.

request_extension_admission_2026_11_13.scope: Transaction planning reserves conservative validation scratch for request-owned extensions before parsing. A managed-pressure fixture proves early budget refusal and preserved document/Redo; after pressure is removed the invalid payload is rejected. Core library, document graph, trim archive and seven native 3DM fixtures pass.
request_extension_admission_2026_11_13.remaining: This does not enable metadata above the 16 KiB default. Physical OOM, native peak, desktop debug adapter and all other allocation paths remain open; Plan A remains open.
request_extension_admission_2026_11_13.next_action: Implement bounded large-trim representation across model, archive, scene and commands; reconcile the debug adapter without disrupting active sessions.

extension_validation_admission_2026_11_1.scope: Document storage and three transaction request storage-count paths no longer parse extension JSON before scratch admission. Document validation estimates 64x the largest extension payload plus 4096 bytes before validation. Tight-budget and malformed transaction fixtures verify preflight refusal and preserved document/Redo. Core library, archive suite and seven native 3DM fixtures passed.
extension_validation_admission_2026_11_1.remaining: The bound is conservative and may refuse earlier; physical OOM, native peak and every validation entry point remain unverified. Large trim metadata and desktop adapter compatibility remain open; Plan A open.
extension_validation_admission_2026_11_1.next_action: Design and implement safe large-trim representation and archive admission; reconcile the debug adapter without disturbing active sessions.

ordinary_scene_brep_display_owner_2026_1.scope: Ordinary scene objects borrow BRep display from the validated document during picking/snap instead of independently retaining its Arc; remesh overrides keep their own lease.
ordinary_scene_brep_display_owner_2026_1.limitations: Full scene snapshots retain documents; document/Undo display eviction, native/process peak and desktop remain open.

unattested_v4_sphere_fallback_2026_11_06.scope: A v4 Sphere with a structurally valid but unattested changed face ID retains its display and CPU-pick identity when a remesh request is refused for missing proof.
unattested_v4_sphere_fallback_2026_11_06.limitations: In-memory archive and headless controller only; no production eviction, native topology attestation, disk lifecycle, desktop or GPU proof.

remesh_two_root_lease_2026_11_06.scope: The aggregate original scene-buffer lease follows remaining original buffers instead of remeshed buffer owners. A two-root sequential remesh retains it through an old snapshot and releases it after the last snapshot drops.
remesh_two_root_lease_2026_11_06.limitations: Partial replacement still retains the aggregate charge; remesh is experimental and document/Undo retain display.

remesh_buffer_lease_lifetime_2026_11_06.scope: When remesh replaces every original scene buffer, the new owner no longer retains the original lease; old snapshots keep it until their final drop. A remaining root continues to retain the original lease.
remesh_buffer_lease_lifetime_2026_11_06.limitations: Partial replacement retains a conservative aggregate charge. The remesh route is experimental and document/Undo still own display.

remesh_proof_placement_undo_2026_11_06.scope: Optional topology proof survives a placement-only revision for full revalidation before remesh; a Sphere fixture covers move, Undo/Redo, stale receipts, changed source and scratch refusal.
remesh_proof_placement_undo_2026_11_06.limitations: The attested primitive/remesh route remains test-only; Undo removing the object drops its proof, and document/history still retain display.

gumball_remesh_scene_identity_2026_11_06.scope: Gumball mesh-centre cache checks scene publication identity as well as document epoch and selection; the Sphere remesh regression changed from failure to pass.
gumball_remesh_scene_identity_2026_11_06.limitations: Remesh Sphere proof is test-only; display remains retained by document and Undo. Desktop and GPU image not checked.

sphere_controller_pick_snap_export_2026_.scope: A production Sphere command and Gumball fixture verifies CPU face picking, stale pick/snap refusal, source-refined surface snap and fixed-profile STL bytes across Undo/Redo.
sphere_controller_pick_snap_export_2026_.limitations: One controller fixture, without cache eviction/remesh, GPU or desktop. Document and Undo still retain display.

sphere_translated_source_bounds_2026_11_.scope: For pure translation, OCCT source bounds use a shape location preserving analytic geometry. The production Sphere command and Gumball fixture verifies source, topology, scene placement, bounds and Undo/Redo.
sphere_translated_source_bounds_2026_11_.limitations: Not a general bounds error certificate or desktop test. Document and Undo still retain display and cannot yet evict it.

brep_source_integrity_2026_11_06.scope: The in-memory B-rep source owner retains and validates an integrity digest covering source and topology IDs.
brep_source_integrity_2026_11_06.limitations: Not a native topology attestation; v4 reconstructs the digest, and document/Undo still retain display.

brep_embedded_source_owner_2026_11_06.scope: Production B-rep embeds the existing source/topology owner and keeps the existing v4 serialization and shared-allocation accounting.
brep_embedded_source_owner_2026_11_06.limitations: Representation refactor only; placement is separate, native topology binding is not proved, and document/Undo still retain display.

remove_scene_high_water_2026_11_05.scope: Remove obsolete shared scene high-water and scene-byte capture estimates; require registered scene ownership before STL capture. Preserve live owners, structural quantities and explicit remaining auxiliary-snapshot limitation.
remove_scene_high_water_2026_11_05.verification: Final scene-peak-removal-20261105-071248: 287 distinct passed/7 ignored/0 failed; STL 63 incl 2 new, GPU 29/no SKIP, native STL 60; source scan has no legacy counter names.
remove_scene_high_water_2026_11_05.remaining: Caller auxiliary remains a snapshot; workspace/file/recent/pending R1a, wider R1b/native/RSS/UI export/P1-P5 and desktop remain open. No measured memory/FPS gain or global STL/3DM accuracy claim.

live_subselection_memory_2026_11_05.scope: R1a subselection: live CPU ownership of slots and nested paths, allocated-only transfer between same-account/class guards, phased old/new slots and input-path materialization, removal/drop without stale capture double charge
live_subselection_memory_2026_11_05.verification: 601 distinct passed/7 ignored/0 failed: core 325 includes allocated-transfer 2; subselection 3; app/native/GPU groups documented. GPU 29/no SKIP, native STL 60; no new release/desktop/RSS measurements.
live_subselection_memory_2026_11_05.remaining: Workspace/path/recent/pending/high-water R1a and caller/query/peer/retired R1b remain. Native peak, UI export, P1-P5, GPU batching and STL/3DM accuracy gates remain open; allocation ownership does not certify process RSS or native safety.

live_root_selection_memory_2026_11_05.scope: R1a root selection: pre-admitted live CPU owner for tree/order and staged plugin selection; detach capture observes growth/removal/drop via shared account without capture-time double charge
live_root_selection_memory_2026_11_05.verification: Final scoped groups: 322 distinct passed/7 ignored/0 failed; GPU 29/no SKIP, native STL 60. Original overlay baseline oracle failure retained; exact live selection bill added, timeout/stale assertions unchanged.
live_root_selection_memory_2026_11_05.remaining: Root selection only. BTree bill is a pinned-profile allowance; other auxiliary/high-water, scratch/peer/retired/native/RSS, UI export, P1-P5 and release/desktop remain open. No FPS or global geometric certification claim.

stl_shared_admission_peer_2026_11_05.scope: R1a peer portion: reuse the existing shared-account admission peer for STL capture, preserving cache quota at the tested managed ceiling and source authority without a temporary identity/account adoption
stl_shared_admission_peer_2026_11_05.verification: Final stl-peer-20261105-061229: 169 distinct passed/6 large ignored/0 failed; STL unit 60 includes new peer 2, replacement 8, lifecycle 12+20+9, native STL integration 60. Initial zero-test filter run rejected, not evidence.
stl_shared_admission_peer_2026_11_05.remaining: R1a live auxiliary/high-water ownership, wider peer/journal/retired inventory, native pre-copy peak, UI worker and P1-P5 remain open. No new RSS/native peak, GPU, release or desktop measurement; no claimed material memory/FPS gain.

presentation_weak_allocation_lifetime_20.scope: Separate presentation Scene storage from its Weak-retained block and share one allocation allowance through cached Weak/strong reader lifetimes; prune expired predecessor before successor admission
presentation_weak_allocation_lifetime_20.verification: Reproduced expired Weak undercharge red to green. Final 176 distinct passes/1 opt-in measurement ignored; GPU 29/no SKIP. Three new empty-template fixtures plus exact lifecycle/metadata checks.
presentation_weak_allocation_lifetime_20.remaining: Only presentation allocation ownership. Cache containers/pool, auxiliary/peer/retired/query owners, native/RSS, UI export, P1-P5 and release/desktop remain open. Incremental buffer-chain leakage was not reproduced and is not claimed fixed.

external_memory_refusal_provenance_2026_.scope: One historical final refusal for external reservations/grow, captured under admission lock with actual operands/headroom and coordinator origin; successful eviction retries do not publish a refusal
external_memory_refusal_provenance_2026_.verification: 440 distinct passes, GPU 29/no SKIP; real external-admission failure operands and successful retry semantics tested. Dev MCP binary returns 9 replies with unchanged Point state and additive refusal/origin fields.
external_memory_refusal_provenance_2026_.remaining: Only external reservation/grow entrypoints. Other retained/publication/recheck/codec/native/job provenance, full owner attribution, bounded UI/logging, native/RSS, P1-P5 and release/desktop remain open. An allocation refusal is not a verdict that a CAD command failed.

on_demand_memory_diagnostics_2026_11_05.scope: Read-only storage/probe diagnostics via core and om9_memory MCP, including overage, unknown states, pending/materialized and independent physical/commit request observations
on_demand_memory_diagnostics_2026_11_05.verification: 452 distinct final tests passed, 29 GPU/no SKIP; dev binary --mcp returned 9 replies with unchanged Point fixture and measured Windows RAM/commit. Read-only/overage/error states covered.
on_demand_memory_diagnostics_2026_11_05.remaining: No full R1/native/RSS bound. Known storage inventory is synchronous on demand, so large-model/nonblocking UI remains unverified; actual failed-request/codec attribution, missing owners, exact Undo age, UI export, P1-P5 and release/desktop remain open. Running desktop/connector was not updated.

account_root_weak_document_memory_2026_1.scope: Admit active shared-account fixed roots at startup; count expired external Document Weak blocks once and retire expired validation proofs without retaining historical metadata peaks
account_root_weak_document_memory_2026_1.verification: Three regressions red to green; final core 312 (retained 104 included), 641 distinct total passes/7 ignored across selected current-source checks. No GPU SKIP.
account_root_weak_document_memory_2026_1.remaining: Fixed roots of current shared account and known Weak/proof ownership only. Retired account handles, peer/journal/auxiliary/query owners, diagnostics, native envelope, UI export, P1-P5 and release/desktop remain open; no RSS or whole-process memory bound.

picking_cache_recency_qos_2026_11_05.scope: Shared picking cache admission reclaims unused quotas before warm arenas, tracks interactive read recency in the existing weak index, and gives render bounds a nonallocating passive read path
picking_cache_recency_qos_2026_11_05.verification: Two policy regressions red to green; 15 managed tests/16 canonical 200-point fixtures; 263 distinct final passes and 1 ignored, including 29 GPU offscreen. No adapter SKIP.
picking_cache_recency_qos_2026_11_05.remaining: CPU cache policy and offscreen publication evidence only. Normal close culling stays disabled; no desktop FPS improvement inferred. Model-scale churn/latency, other R1 owners/diagnostics, native envelope, UI export worker, P1-P5 and full plan remain open.

picking_cache_pressure_2026_11_05.scope: Shared-account CPU picking cache/quota pressure reclamation and automatic readmission; owned read handles retain data and leases through preview, eviction and Scene drop
picking_cache_pressure_2026_11_05.verification: Final targeted 257 passed, 1 ignored including 28 GPU offscreen; 10 managed cache tests use 11 canonical 200-point fixtures. No desktop measurement.
picking_cache_pressure_2026_11_05.remaining: CPU picking only. Near-ceiling churn/QoS, other cache and registry/peer/journal/query/auxiliary owners, native allocation envelope, UI export worker, GPU batching and release/desktop remain open. No process RSS bound or whole-plan completion.

staged_stl_shared_admission_2026_11_05.scope: Replace whole-headroom captured/Controller and detached STL leases with shared phase admission; add Rust native-source/snapshot copy hooks, preserve typed refusal and selection allocation phases
staged_stl_shared_admission_2026_11_05.limitations: Native conversion/meshing allocations precede copy callbacks and are not bounded by this admission. Topology/hash scratch stays estimated pending; full allocator/path/worker/receipt ownership, automatic eviction, UI background integration, release/desktop and the rest of P1-P5 remain open.

scene_metadata_picking_and_save_2026_11_.scope: Main-scene metadata/picking arena ownership through candidate/history/file publication and snapshot workers; Save admits buffer/decoder phases rather than remaining headroom
scene_metadata_picking_and_save_2026_11_.limitations: R1 remains open for automatic pressure eviction/re-admission, optional pending arena quota retention, query/auxiliary/native owners and diagnostics. Save decoder scratch remains estimated pending within each phase; no current release/desktop or allocator/RSS bound. Captured/detached STL still reserve all remaining headroom; P1-P5 open.

controller_commit_and_snapshot_metadata_.scope: Windows Controller installs shared commit probe; metadata snapshot phases reconcile capacity; commit refusal preserves scene and Redo before retry
controller_commit_and_snapshot_metadata_.limitations: Main-scene metadata, lazy picking cache owners, native peaks, staged task budgets and desktop remain open.

pending_allocated_ram_2026_11_05.limitations: Metadata/lazy caches, high-water estimates, commit headroom, native peaks and desktop remain open; six large RAM fixtures ignored.

snapshot_master_scene_publication_2026_1.limitations: Metadata/lazy caches, pending/live accounting, native peaks, release and desktop remain open. Six large RAM fixtures ignored.

history_scene_buffer_registration_2026_1.limitations: Snapshot/Master, lazy cache owners, OS pressure and desktop remain open.

full_candidate_buffer_publication_2026_1.limitations: History and snapshot/Master publication, lazy caches, physical pressure and desktop remain open.

initial_scene_buffer_registration_2026_1.limitations: Other scene publication paths, lazy caches, pending/live accounting and desktop remain open.

plugin_candidate_scene_admission_2026_11.limitations: Persistent scene/cache ownership and native peaks remain open.

clipboard_candidate_scene_admission_2026.limitations: No continuous published-scene owner or native peak bound; desktop not tested.

top11_candidate_scene_admission_2026_11_.limitations: Actual capacity reconciled after allocation; persistent scene ownership, native peaks and desktop remain open.

tasks: Audit exact L3 source and standalone evidence; reuse the existing Rust service where present. Do not infer completion from planning metadata.

For an SDK-eligible feature, implement public DTO/wrapper/capability and host dispatch in the same owner delivery as the application service; existing completed core code receives an explicit SDK retrofit task here.
Preserve units, coordinate spaces, permissions, revision/identity, budgets, cancellation and host-owned atomic transaction/Undo semantics.
Verify an external plugin built from the public SDK, geometry/metadata parity, error/Cancel/Undo/Redo and persistence where relevant; prove each advertised native target separately.
Update this owner, its affected L3 traceability/runtime evidence, API inventory/example and live ledger; keep unverified SDK scope open without erasing prior core evidence.
sdk_integration_plan.completion_rule: For SDK-eligible scope, the owner delivery includes the public contract, host route, shared service and external plugin evidence. Host-internal exceptions require a documented ownership reason. Existing business/manual gates remain in force.
sdk_integration_plan.target_evidence_policy: Windows and macOS execution are recorded separately; shared source or a package target entry does not prove macOS runtime.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Public SDK v1 export of the document owner's read/write attribute services: a filtered paged object query with generation and geometry/attributes revisions, one object attribute record, one staged attribute edit and one staged rename. The host evaluates staged records with Document::permissions_for_attributes (the same layer chain the application uses) and emits Mutation::Attributes/Mutation::Label; no mutable Document crosses the ABI.
l3_open: a layer created in the same command cannot receive newly added objects
groups, blocks/instances, jewellery extension records, change notification, snapshot/restore and import provenance have no plugin surface
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: One command stages at most one of transform, attributes or rename per object (the document transaction allows one source write per object). Attribute edits require an editable layer; object-level locked/hidden stay editable. This record does not close the L2 or its other child L3.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Public SDK v1 export of the document owner's layer service: create a layer (optional make-current), rename/recolour/reflag one layer, select or clear the current layer, and assign existing or already staged objects to an existing or this-command-created layer. Plans are LayerAction/LayerPlan captured through the coordinator; staged layer records are evaluated with Document::layer_permissions_with and permissions_for_attributes_with.
l3_open: groups, blocks/instances, change notification, snapshot/restore and import provenance have no plugin surface
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: One layer write per layer per command. Adding objects to a layer whose flags change in the same command, and assigning objects off such a source layer, are refused by the application's permission-read rule. Assignment is an attribute write, so it conflicts with a transform, attribute edit or rename of the same object.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Same-command output into a layer this command creates: the transaction insert admission resolves the proposed layer record and its captured parent chain, so layer_create(make_current) followed by add_object publishes one transaction and one Undo unit. The permission-read overlap excludes only layers created by that request; a layer whose flags change in the same request still refuses output.
l3_open: Mutation::Publish and cross-document Move keep base-layer validation
groups, blocks/instances, change notification, snapshot/restore and import provenance have no plugin surface
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Only the insert path into a proposed layer is admitted. The anti-bypass rule for captured layers (flags changing in the same request) is unchanged.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Object extension slots read/write: verbatim JSON-object payload with a positive version, bounded slot name, merged staged reads and Mutation::Extension write under the one-source-write-per-object rule. An object created in the same command must be tagged next command.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Payloads are opaque text; schema/version meaning stays with the plugin.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Object placement write: one affine matrix (row-major local->world) through Mutation::Placement, validated by Transform::validate, under the one-source-write-per-object rule; Undo restores the previous matrix.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: One object's matrix only; instance/block transforms remain open.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Polygon mesh creation: add_mesh publishes vertices/faces through Mesh::validate and the shared output path; an out-of-range index is a mesh refusal; one transaction/Undo.

Recorded change feed: one bounded batch per plugin command, real from/to revisions, entity/layer entries, readable by the next plugin command. Host-command recording beyond the plugin boundary is documented as open.
Layer order read (bottom to top), including a layer created by the same command.
Feed covers plugin commands plus host Undo/Redo with real revisions and cause.
sdk_implementation_progress.limits: Plugin commands and host Undo/Redo only.

sdk_implementation_progress.scope: Group records read (id/name/members/revision).
Block definition read (id/label/member count/revision).
Clear current layer (no-op when already clear).
Object placement read (base or staged matrix).
Single object record read (same ObjectInfo as query).
